items.text: AYUSH degrees beyond BAMS, such as homeopathy, unani, naturopathy and yoga programmes, lead to registered practice, teaching, research, wellness and public health roles, and they must be practised within the law, with honest claims and a clear view of what the evidence supports.
Choose the system you believe in and are willing to practise responsibly, check recognition and registration, and build a plan that works whether clinical seats and patients are slow to come.
Recognised degrees, regulatory councils, registration, permitted practice and admission rules differ by system and state and change.
